title: AstroGen: a lightweight library of generative-model cores for astronomy data
description: AstroGen is a lightweight library of generative-model cores for astronomy data. It provides reusable diffusion and variational model implementations (DDPM, class-conditional DDPM, VAE, super-resolution and denoising diffusion) for images, spectra, and simulation volumes, without owning a heavy data-processing stack. Conditioning is treated as a first-class model capability: class labels, physical parameters, and observations use a consistent interface, and building blocks are shared across 1D spectra, 2D images, and 3D volumes.
